title: Shan Language Curriculum Grade 4 (ပပ်ႉႁဵၼ်းလိၵ်ႈတႆး ၸၼ်ႉသီႇ)
author: Shan State Education Department (ၸုမ်းပၢႆးပိင်ႇၺႃႇၸိုင်ႈတႆး)
genre: Advanced Southwestern Tai Prose, Poetry & Didactic Literature
description: Comprehensive fourth-grade vernacular reader published by the Education Department of Shan State, Taunggyi, introducing upper primary students to advanced Southwestern Tai grammar, narrative prose fables (Lik Pung), historical accounts of the Shan plateaus, moral dialogues, and metric verse composition.

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ ႁဵၼ်း လိၵ်ႈ တႆး ၸၼ်ႉ သီႇ ပဵၼ် တႃႇ ႁဵၼ်း ၵႂၢမ်း လိၵ်ႈ ၸၼ်ႉ သုင်
sentences.text_roman: pap hen lik tai can si pen ta hen kwam lik can sung

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai Language Grade 4 textbook is designed for advanced study of written composition and literature.
